title: The old Bentley limousine he and Mary Lou are restoring
summary: He tells how they came to buy the 1956 English limousine and the fun they have with it.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: She's an all-around genius type, really. Anything she puts her mind to, she does very well. We have this old Bentley... Actually it's a Vine(?) & (?) Princess in the old 1956 English limousine. The history of it, it was actually in the diplomatic corps. We have some papers to prove all this. Anyhow, we are tearing all the insides out, and she is reupholstering herself, and I am doing the outside stuff.
Well, wonderful. Where did you get it? How did you get it?

Well, we were in London some years ago, and we wanted to buy an old English taxi, you know. So someone heard of this when we got back here, through Jimmy Talbert, and the guy came around saying, "Hey, I just imported this old car, and would you like to see it?" So he sent us a couple of tickets to come up to Burlingame in the Bay Area, and we saw it and fell in love with it, and so bought it and we've had it for about eight years. Now it's taking up so much space, we're going to cherry it up and get rid of it.
Do you think you'll be able to part with it?
Yeah.
Callender (#3) - 26
Really?

Oh, sure. You know, we've had a lot of fun with it. It's a limousine with the glass in between, and the steering wheel on the right side. So every now and then we go out for a ride. We went up north for a ride in it, and she'd chauffeur me and I'd sit in the back, you know. Quite funny! And vice-versa. And then she sits up front with me. So just a couple of weeks ago we were taking it down to San Diego, and on the way we stopped at a little deli to pick up a pack of cigarettes, and Mary Lou goes in the store and a Japanese lady said, "Ah, your chauffeur..." I got out and I bowed. Having been to Japan, you know, I did my little bow and they bowed back. So the lady said, "Your chauffeur is nice. He bowed to us." [LAUGHS] We have a little subtle fun like that sometimes.
It sounds like it's too much fun to part with, really.
Well...where...
For the special fun occasion.

Well, we will. But it takes up a lot of space, and we're living in a condominium now, and we have to keep it in the garage, naturally. Mary Lou has got her classic Mustang, you know, she has a '65 Mustang, and I've got the Volvo -- and so there's three cars and two parking
Callender (#3) - 27
places. So we think if we get the right price, we'll part with it and invest in a smaller car. It's a huge car, but believe it or not, it's 6 cylinders and it gets 17 miles to a gallon.
Gee!
You've never seen it?
No, I've never seen it.
Well, I'll have to drive it up here when we get finished with the inside.
Oh, please! I'd love it. I'll take a picture.
Ooh, I could have brought some. We have some wild pictures of... We want to take pictures of it.
